cetus.dayheader: Cetus - Rise and Shine! Hunting time Over!

reset.tooltip:
Daily Reset timer is based on your computer's clock.
Make sure it's in sync!

sentientoutpost.tooltip1: This component is in active development because of the recent update.
sentientoutpost.tooltip2: Estimated cycle is 30 minutes of active time on each node.

settings.componentsHelp: Toggle panels on or off. On the timers page, use Customize layout to drag panels into order and use the eye icon to preview or hide individual panels.
settings.fissuresHelp: Tagged planets are hidden from fissure, void storm, and steel path lists. Use Customize layout on the timers page to show or hide whole fissure panels.
settings.notificationsHelp: Add tags for entries you want notifications for. Search in each dropdown, then pick multiple options.
settings.soundsHelp: Enable sounds for matching notifications. Use play to preview each tone.

timersLayout.editHint: Drag panels in the grid to reorder. Drop panels into Hidden below to turn them off, or drag them back up to show them again. Use the eye icon for a quick hide/show.
timersLayout.hiddenEmptyHint: Drag a panel here to hide it, or use the eye icon on an active panel.
timersLayout.hiddenRestoreHint: Drag panels back into the grid above to show them again.
timersLayout.placeholderHint: Hidden — drag back into the grid or use the eye icon.

staleData.message: API data is over 5 minutes old.
